run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the minimized maximum height difference for an array given n and k
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and count successes
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold algorithm that minimizes maximum height difference by adding or subtracting k
review_f_gold: review f_gold which sorts the array and adjusts small and big bounds to minimize height difference
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to accept only arr and k parameters instead of the redundant n argument
